The SMILES with atom mapping brackets may be invalid for the tool. Need to provide plain SMILES without atom mapping. The target SMILES originally: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

We need to convert to canonical SMILES without mapping: CH2=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(O)C1C(F)(F)F? Let's generate: The core: CH2= C( phenyl ) - C1CCC(O)C1C(F)(F)F. The stereochemistry maybe not needed. So SMILES: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(O)C1C(F)(F)F. But need double bond: CH2= C(...). So "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(O)C1C(F)(F)F". That is "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(O)C1C(F)(F)F". However need explicit double bond: "C= C(...)" maybe ambiguous. Use "C= C" with spaces not allowed. Should be "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(O)C1C(F)(F)F". That is correct.
